capabilities: Set custom names and remarks for files
Remind when a file's review expires
extras: README is a bare feature list with a demo section whose content is not included; no usage instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule files for review based on a forgetting curve so you remember their content over time.
summary: Review tracker that applies a forgetting curve to vault files, with labels, custom names, remarks and expiration reminders.
